sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO company_personnel (gameid, companyid, periodid, employee_title, employee_type_count, employee_type_adds, employee_type_loss) VALUES (#gameid#, #companyid#, #periodid#, #employeeType#, #employeeTypeCount#, #employeeTypeHires#, #employeeTypeFires#)
sqlMap.delete: DELETE FROM company_personnel WHERE companyid = #companyid# AND periodid = #periodid# AND employee_title = #employeeType#
sqlMap.select: SELECT ap.employee_title, ap.employee_cost_per_period, ap.employee_hiring_cost, ap.employee_firing_cost, cp.companyid, cp.periodid, cp.employee_type_count, cp.employee_type_adds, cp.employee_type_loss FROM available_personnel ap LEFT JOIN (SELECT companyid, periodid, employee_title, employee_type_count, employee_type_adds, employee_type_loss FROM company_personnel WHERE companyid = #companyid# AND periodid = #periodid# ) cp ON ap.employee_title = cp.employee_title WHERE gameid = #gameid#

SELECT ap.employee_title, ap.employee_cost_per_period, ap.employee_hiring_cost, ap.employee_firing_cost, cp.companyid, cp.periodid, cp.employee_type_count, cp.employee_type_adds, cp.employee_type_loss FROM available_personnel ap LEFT JOIN (SELECT companyid, periodid, employee_title, employee_type_count, employee_type_adds, employee_type_loss FROM company_personnel WHERE companyid = #companyid# AND periodid = #periodid# ) cp ON ap.employee_title = cp.employee_title WHERE gameid = #gameid# AND ap.employee_title = #employeeType#

SELECT cp.employee_title, cp.employee_type_count, cp.employee_type_adds, cp.employee_type_loss FROM company_personnel cp WHERE companyid = #companyid# AND periodid = #periodid# AND employee_title = #employeeType#
